responsibility: Defines the ISO rewindable sequential-file channel interface. It declares operations to open sequential files for writing, appending, or reading, test whether a channel is such a file, switch an existing channel back to reread or rewrite mode, and close it, providing the public API for file devices that support position reset to the beginning but are used through sequential text/raw channel operations.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the API/specification half of the SeqFile pair: it declares the rewindable sequential-file channel operations and related types/constants, while SeqFile.mod implements the device hooks, file opening, reset, and close behavior.
